notes.title: Rogue Cell 1.1 Released!
notes.content: [p]We're happy to announce that the first update for Rogue Cell, version 1.1, has been released! We tried hard to get this one out while the game is still on sale. This update includes New Game+, quality of life improvements, and some bug fixes, outlined below.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556192/d224bc8dfc2e09fc163f0078a98aabf8b4f4f7a4.png"][/img][/p][h3]New Game+[/h3][p]Spoilers ahead for those who want to experience it for themselves![/p][p]NG+ is a mode that will unlock once you have completed the main game. For those who have already beaten the boss, this mode should automatically unlock. You can access this mode from the main menu by selecting New Game+.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556192/5702c38dff86c8674ca2f0bc2a86fd039dc4e312.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As hinted at in the above notification, NG+ will throw hazards at you right from the start, including prey cells, predator cells, viruses, and a couple new variants:[/p][list][*][p]Fast Prey: these speedy cells are similar to regular prey cells, except they will zip by at greater speeds and won't deviate to grab mass.[/p][/*][*][p]Tiny Viruses: these smaller viruses will drift through the environment and act as an early-game hazard that players can avoid or take advantage of.[/p][/*][*][p]Worker-Spawning Predators: these super predators act like other super predators, except they've learned the mystical art of creating worker cells to collect mass. Keep an eye out for these early-game giants.[/p][/*][/list][p]Prices in the upgrade tree have also been increased by 50% for this mode, and if that's not enough, a [i]respawn[/i] [i]cost[/i] will take 25% of your DNA, so be sure to spend it while you have it, and plan ahead before hoarding points.[/p][p]This mode also features times to beat in a post-game, local leaderboard, as well as a timer to keep track of how fast you're progressing. We've already seen a pretty incredible completion time in the beta:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556192/6060d854a8cb9c94e84b7cf51e9c9ba3b421823e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Quality of Life[/h3][p]On the QoL side, three big changes have been made.[/p][list][*][p]An indicator has been added to the upgrade panel, to indicate that there are upgrades available down below the bottom of the screen, for those upgrades you might have missed while scrolling up.[/p][/*][*][p]Some players were confused by Immune System and Beneficial Virus. Immune System gives you a 50% chance to survive a virus, rewarding you with nothing if your survive absorbing a virus, while Beneficial Virus would add DNA to that survival. Some players missed the connection, so to simplify it, we've moved Beneficial Virus to be a requirement for Immune System II, and to come after Immune System. Immune System will now give a small amount of DNA on survival, with Beneficial Virus boosting the amount, as it felt very underwhelming to get nothing for surviving.[/p][/*][*][p]Some players reported some [i]very[/i] bad luck with rolling that 50/50 chance with Immune System. While mathematically possible to get 40+ deaths in a row, it's not exactly [i]fun[/i]. So to remedy this, we've updated the coin flip to be more "smooth". You should expect far fewer deaths in a row. And, to encourage players to give it a try (and to not discourage it right after unlocking), the first virus after unlocking the upgrade will always be a successful roll.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bugs[/h3][p]Suspiciously few bugs... If you've spotted any, please let us know in the Discussions section of the Community Hub, or by contacting us directly at [url="https://contact@maplelike.com"]contact@maplelike.com[/url][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with the boss' damage roar using the wrong roar clip and being too quiet to even notice.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed confirmation popup not always auto-center-aligning text when displaying 1-2 lines.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed keyboard/joystick navigation of the options menu, where options would not auto-scroll fully into view on all resolutions.[/p][/*][/list][p]There are two issues we still have on the list that are being looked at:[/p][list][*][p]We have had a few reports of achievements not always popping while in-game, and while they [i]do[/i] appear after closing the game, this is a big feel-bad moment. While we don't have the solution yet, this [i]is[/i] something we're looking into, to determine if it's on the project side, the Steam SDK side, or on Steam's end.[/p][/*][*][p]D-Pad for some controllers still do not work when navigating menus. This is on our list, and we're attempting to source controllers to reproduce this in order to find a fix. We apologize for the inconvenience![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Future Plans[/h3][p]Speaking personally now, Rogue Cell 1.0 was the full game that I set out to make. Version 1.1 builds on that with some quality of life improvements and a New Game+ mode, all inspired by feedback from you. At this point, I consider the game feature-complete. I don’t currently have plans for future content, but I’m always open to ideas and will still work on patches to fix any bugs that crop up. If there's something you'd love to see though, please feel free to share, as I'm not closing the door on future content. But for now, I'll be setting my sights on future projects.[/p][p]This has been a personal project from the start, with help from friends, as a way to both challenge myself and showcase what I can build independently, and so I'm thrilled to see such a positive response to something I've made and put out there. I appreciate all of your support.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556192/b0995e3f4992db8f40b4642b964007b6f4eb30d3.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Rogue Cell 1.1 Plans
notes.content: [h3]Version 1.1 Plans[/h3][p]Rogue Cell's release came with a lot of great feedback, and we've loved hearing it. You enjoyed the game; it's the perfect balance of short and sweet, it's got a lot of polish, it's incredibly relaxing, but you want just a [i]bit[/i] more out of it. We get it! Rogue Cell might have started as a solo developer's portfolio piece, but why not make that portfolio piece just a bit bigger? So, with nothing better to do, we've started working on a Version 1.1 update that will bring a few quality of life improvements as well as a challenging New Game+ to attempt.[/p][p][/p][p]While we can't promise a specific date, we are aiming to have 1.1 published within the next week, so stay tuned for an update announcement.[/p][p][/p][h3]NG+[/h3][p]New Game+ will unlock after completing the main game. It will crank up the difficulty and start you off in a very hostile environment, making you work for those DNA points. We don't want to give too much away and over-promise, as this feature is still being worked on, but we hope it will give you a satisfying challenge.[/p][p][/p][h3]QOL + Bugs[/h3][p]For quality of life improvements? Well, that list is [i]evolving[/i], and if you have any suggestions or things you'd like to see added to version 1.1, please let us know![/p][p]No bugs have been reported yet, but if you do encounter anything funny or not working quite right, share your feedback and report bugs so we can fix them. For now, you can report bugs and feedback to [u]contact@maplelike.com[/u].[/p][p][/p][h3]Thank You[/h3][p]Thank you all so much for giving this game a try. Coming from me, the developer, personally, I can't overstate how thrilled I am that people are actually playing something that I created, and I'm excited to get version 1.1 out for you all to enjoy.[/p]
